# File formats

The machine-file formats StitchCraft writes. How each is encoded, and why, is in the [machine formats design](../../design/formats.md).

| Format | Extension | Colour changes and stops | Colours stored as |
|---|---|---|---|
| PES v1 | `.pes` | at most 255 | indices into the Brother PEC palette (nearest colour, CIEDE2000) |
| DST | `.dst` | at most 999 | nothing: the machine pauses and the operator loads the next thread |
